name: Tottemo Harem
source:
Although our main character is an infamous slacker due to not having any extracurricular activities after classes or a part-time job; he’s going to have his hands full with a few ways than one. His father is the complete antithesis of him, a man married to his work--which is why the mother left the family. Yet somehow the over-working, non-feeling father bags another wife (who happens to have a daughter of her own). By matters not completely apparent to White Masq; our hero begins to pursue all his crushes and infatuations in both school and at home to build a harem. Perhaps because they all seem to work, he’s trying to leech off of them all? If that is the case, he’s found a way to compensate them!

[By DeathMarine]
